assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: Matkakirja Athens detail image; original historical illustration with a photographic appearance, not a documentary photograph.
Primary request: Create exactly one entirely new image from this text alone: an imaginative but restrained night-building scene showing anonymous islander craftsmen from Anafi constructing their own tiny stone dwelling beneath the Acropolis in the middle of the nineteenth century. Do not assign an exact year or decade. The scene is our own spatial interpretation, not a replica of present-day Anafiotika houses or any photograph or artwork.
Scene/backdrop: A narrow rough ledge immediately against the large natural limestone cliff of the Acropolis. The cliff itself occupies the whole background, with just an old plain fortification-wall silhouette along its upper edge and a small strip of dark sky. There is NO distant city view, NO horizon of houses, NO modern building, NO finished neoclassical facade: the close cliff physically blocks any view beyond this little building site. A modest moon and only a few faint stars above the cliff, not a fantasy starfield.
Subject: Exactly six anonymous fully clothed adult island craftsmen seen from behind or far enough away with heads lowered that faces have no readable features. Some carry rough stones and a clay or wooden mortar container, two lay stone and lime mortar into the wall, another bends over a small stone pile. They wear simple traditional nineteenth-century Cycladic island work clothes: off-white linen shirts, dark plain waistcoats, loose baggy trousers, waist sashes, and simple soft caps or headscarves; subdued worn fabric, no modern clothing, brands, uniforms, helmets or identifiable individual likenesses. Their quiet coordinated work is the point; no face portrait.
House: The main foreground subject is one small unfinished low cubic dwelling with rough natural stone and lime-mortar walls, a simple unfinished opening for a door, and no roof yet. The sides are squat and nearly square, intended for a flat roof. A small part of one wall has fresh dull white limewash, most remains bare stone. No glass window grid, decorative balcony, manufactured concrete blocks, modern cement, electrical fitting, roof tiles or modern house exterior. A few plain stones and unmarked clay/wood containers lie beside the work. Two modest oil lamps in simple pre-electric lanterns light the nearby masonry and hands; no electricity or floodlights.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2 landscape at native 1536x1024. Eye-level three-quarter side view from about eight metres away, six men gathered around the small roofless dwelling in the centre and lower middle. People occupy modest parts of the overall scene and their heads remain back-facing, dark and indistinct. The masonry, lantern light and workers must read clearly in a full-frame 480-pixel preview. The big cliff fills the background, preventing any city architecture from appearing.
Style/medium: Believable real-camera appearance of an imagined historical scene, photographic rough stone, linen and lime texture, restrained available-light night exposure. Natural gentle moonlight plus dim practical oil-flame illumination, realistic soft shadows and modest low-light grain. Muted grey limestone, off-white cloth, dark brown waistcoats, tiny warm lamp highlights. Quiet scene, no cinematic blue-orange grading, no HDR, no painting or drawing, no theatrical spotlights, no glossy CGI.
Constraints: Exactly one opaque RGB sRGB PNG at native 1536x1024. Entirely text-only generation, no reference/source pixels. No readable words, letters, numbers, symbols, inscriptions, logos, signs, watermarks, overlays, label, frame or border. No recognizable faces, no actual historical or living person's likeness, no nude bodies, blood or violence. No modern buildings, vehicles, electricity, electric lights, modern tools, modern scaffolds, plastic buckets, tourists or contemporary clothing.
